findings.summary: StratifiedKFold splits by visit and ignores patient_id, so one patient's visits land in both train and test folds, leaking repeated per-patient features and inflating the reported PR-AUC; use StratifiedGroupKFold with groups=df["patient_id"].

judge.reason: Same defect: row-level StratifiedKFold lets a patient's visits span train and test; proposes group-based split.

findings.label: hit
